facts.text: Promise Scholars provides up to the full cost of tuition after other aid for first-time students graduating from public high schools in Spartanburg, Union, Cherokee, or Greenville counties.

sources.title: Student Scholarships - USC Upstate
sources.quote: Promise Scholars: Up to the full cost of tuition after other aid is applied. Must be a first-time college student graduating from a public high school in Spartanburg, Union, Cherokee or Greenville County
